Events in the year '''[[2026]] in [[Senegal]]'''.

== Incumbents ==
* [[President of Senegal|President]] – [[Bassirou Diomaye Faye]]
* [[Prime Minister of Senegal|Prime Minister]] – [[Ousmane Sonko]] (until 22 May); [[Ahmadou Al Aminou Lo]] (since 25 May)

==Events==
=== January ===
* 18 January – [[Senegal national football team|Senegal]] wins the [[2025 Africa Cup of Nations]] in Morocco, defeating [[Morocco national football team|Morocco]] 1-0 on penalties in the [[2025 Africa Cup of Nations final|final]] at [[Prince Moulay Abdellah Stadium]] in [[Rabat]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Williams |first=Ian |date=18 January 2026 |title=Nigeria edge Egypt on penalties for third place at Cup of Nations |url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/live/cgk8rydnnzkt |access-date=19 January 2026 |website=BBC}}</ref>
*28 January – The [[Confederation of African Football]] fines the [[Senegalese Football Federation]] US$615,000 for [[unsportsmanlike conduct]] during the [[2025 Africa Cup of Nations final|final match]] against Morocco, fines coach [[Pape Thiaw]] US$100,000, and bans him for five [[2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualification|2027 AFCON qualifying matches]]. Players [[Iliman Ndiaye]] and [[Ismaïla Sarr]] are also banned from the first two qualifiers.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Senegal and Morocco fined and banned after AFCON final chaos |url=https://www.dw.com/en/senegal-and-morocco-fined-and-banned-after-afcon-final-chaos/a-75708036 |last=Harding |first=Jonathan |date=2026-01-28 |access-date=2026-01-29 |website=[[Deutsche Welle]]}}</ref>	

=== February ===
* 8 February – Fourteen people are arrested in [[Dakar]] and [[Kaolack]] on suspicion of membership in a child abuse network headed by a French national.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Senegalese police arrest 14 suspects in a child abuse network run by a French national|url=https://apnews.com/article/senegal-child-sex-abuse-rape-france-829fc061ee8bae45785e17982195395e |date=2026-02-09 |access-date=2026-02-09 |website=[[AP News]]}}</ref>
* 10 February – A student dies during protests at [[Cheikh Anta Diop University]] in [[Dakar]] over delayed financial aid, after clashes with security forces and a fire at a campus building. The university is closed the next day "until further notice."<ref>{{Cite web |date=10 February 2026 |title=Student dies as Senegal university protests over finances escalate |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/student-dies-senegal-university-protests-over-finances-escalate-2026-02-10/ |access-date=11 February 2026 |website=Reuters}}</ref>
* 12 February – A patrol boat of the [[Senegalese Navy]] capsizes at the mouth of the [[Senegal River]], leaving three sailors missing and 10 others rescued.<ref>{{cite news|title=Senegal navy patrol boat capsizes, three sailors missing |url=https://www.africanews.com/2026/02/13/senegal-navy-patrol-boat-capsizes-three-sailors-missing/ |access-date=14 February 2026 |work=[[Africanews]] |date=14 February 2026}}</ref>
